language.title: Display Language
language.description: Choose the language used by the Se interface.
language.systemHint: Follows your operating system language when supported.

appearance.description: Customize the look and feel of your terminal.
appearance.zoomHint: Zoom the entire interface (50–300%). Also adjustable with Ctrl+=, Ctrl+-, Ctrl+0.
appearance.fontFamilyHint: Choose a monospace font for terminal text.
appearance.bufferHint: Number of lines to keep in terminal history. Higher values use more memory. Changes apply to new terminals.
appearance.maxTerminalsHint: Maximum number of terminal tabs allowed per project.
appearance.rendererHint: GPU-accelerated rendering for terminal output. WebGL provides best performance. Changes apply to new terminals.
appearance.screenReaderHint: Expose terminal output to NVDA and VoiceOver. Enable only when needed because accessibility rendering can reduce throughput.
appearance.symbolFontHint: Nerd Font used to render prompt icons and powerline glyphs; Auto picks installed Nerd Fonts.

shell.description: Set the default shell for new terminals.
shell.label: Shell
shell.overrideHint: This can be overridden per-project in project settings.

behavior.description: Configure terminal cleanup and editor auto-save behavior.
behavior.openLinksHint: Choose whether Ctrl/Cmd+Click URLs from terminal output open in your system browser or a new Se browser tab.
behavior.orphanDetectionHint: Automatically clean up terminals that have been inactive
behavior.cleanupTimeoutHint: Terminals inactive for this duration will be cleaned up (only if not displayed).
behavior.autoSaveHint: Automatically save editor files after you stop typing
behavior.autoSaveDelayHint: Time to wait after your last edit before saving automatically.

projectDefaults.description: Set default options for new projects.
projectDefaults.colorHint: New projects will use this color by default.

aiAgents.description: View ACP agent availability and warm/auth status. Agent Chat supports these agents automatically.
aiAgents.turnTimeoutHint: Maximum wall-clock duration for a single agent turn. Active turns that stream continuously run until this cap; a silent (wedged) turn errors per the Turn Idle Timeout below. The TERMUL_ACP_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECS env var still overrides this (operator/diagnostic). Desktop only — the standalone server uses the env var.
aiAgents.turnIdleTimeoutHint: Window with no agent activity after which a turn is treated as wedged and cancelled. The TERMUL_ACP_TURN_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS env var still overrides this (operator/diagnostic). Desktop only — the standalone server uses the env var.
aiAgents.sessionNewTimeoutHint: How long to wait for an agent to answer session/new before the spawn fails (cold-start model fetches may need more). The TERMUL_ACP_SESSION_NEW_TIMEOUT_SECS env var still overrides this (operator/diagnostic). Desktop only — the standalone server uses the env var.
aiAgents.sessionReopenTimeoutHint: How long to wait for session/load / session/resume (large histories replay before responding; they may need more). The TERMUL_ACP_SESSION_REOPEN_TIMEOUT_SECS env var still overrides this (operator/diagnostic). Desktop only — the standalone server uses the env var.
aiAgents.firstPromptWarmupHint: Warmup prompt budget after session/new to absorb agent cold-start stalls; choose Disabled to skip the warmup entirely. The TERMUL_ACP_FIRST_PROMPT_WARMUP_SECS env var still overrides this (operator/diagnostic). Desktop only — the standalone server uses the env var.
aiAgents.preferLocalNpmInstallHint: On first launch, download npx agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Qwen, Cline, Auggie) into Se’s local cache and run that copy afterwards. Turn this off to always use npx. Desktop only — the standalone server uses TERMUL_ACP_PREFER_LOCAL_NPM.
aiAgents.cliResumeDescription: Prefixed before the resume flag when launching a scanned session. Edit here or override once in the resume dialog.

mcpServers.description: Configure global MCP servers for capability-aware injection into new chats.

shortcuts.description: Customize keyboard shortcuts to match your workflow.
shortcuts.resetMessage: Are you sure you want to reset all keyboard shortcuts to their default values?

updates.description: Manage application updates and version information.
updates.releaseChannelHint: Choose the Stable, Insider, or Nightly update track.
updates.nightlyWarning: Nightly builds are automated from the latest commit and may be unstable. Updates are offered as a manual download from the nightly release page.
updates.insiderWarning: Insider release candidates may be unfinished. Updates are offered as a manual download from the insider release page.
updates.aurHint: Update through AUR with: yay -S se-manager
updates.manualHint: Automatic update is unavailable. Please download and install the latest version manually.
updates.downloadHint: A new version is ready to download.
updates.autoUpdateHint: When enabled, the app will periodically check for new versions
updates.skippingHint: This version will not be offered again until a newer version is available.

remoteAccess.description: Choose how phones reach this desktop: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel, a named Cloudflare hostname, FRP, or an SSH reverse tunnel to your VPS.
remoteAccess.desktopOnly: Tunnel providers are configured on the desktop app. The phone client only opens the resulting link.
remoteAccess.tokenSet: A token is already saved in Remote Access settings. Enter a new value to replace it.

hints.cloudflareQuick: Zero setup. Each enable creates a new https://*.trycloudflare.com URL.
hints.cloudflareNamed: Uses the bundled cloudflared binary with your tunnel token. Point Cloudflare ingress at http://127.0.0.1 and the local port below.
hints.frp: Runs frpc against your frps. Provide a custom domain (HTTP proxy) or a remote port (TCP). Install frpc or set TERMUL_FRPC_PATH.
hints.sshReverse: Runs ssh -N -R to your VPS. Put Caddy or Nginx in front of 127.0.0.1 on the remote port. Uses ssh-agent or a saved private key — never a password.

remoteAccess.namedHostnameHint: The hostname already routed to this named tunnel, for example se.example.com.
remoteAccess.namedLocalPortHint: Stable loopback port (default 18787) so Cloudflare ingress can target http://127.0.0.1:18787.
remoteAccess.namedTokenHint: From the Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnel page. Saved with Remote Access settings.
remoteAccess.frpServerAddrHint: Host or IP of your frps. Do not include a URL scheme.
remoteAccess.frpServerPortHint: frps bind port. Defaults to 7000 when left empty.
remoteAccess.frpCustomDomainHint: Preferred. frpc publishes this hostname through frps. Leave empty to use a remote TCP port instead.
remoteAccess.frpRemotePortHint: Used only when no custom domain is set. Put TLS in front of this port if you keep HTTPS enabled.
remoteAccess.frpTokenHint: Must match frps auth.token. Saved with Remote Access settings.
remoteAccess.frpPublicHttpsHint: Leave on when a reverse proxy terminates TLS. Turn off only for trusted HTTP test setups.
remoteAccess.sshHostHint: VPS hostname or IP. Do not include a user or URL scheme.
remoteAccess.sshRemotePortHint: Port bound on 127.0.0.1 on the VPS. Point your reverse proxy there.
remoteAccess.sshPublicHostnameHint: The hostname (and optional port) drawn into the QR, for example se.example.com.
remoteAccess.sshPrivateKeyHint: Leave empty to use ssh-agent. Paste a private key to store it with Remote Access settings.
remoteAccess.sshPublicHttpsHint: Leave on when the VPS terminates TLS. Turn off only for trusted HTTP test setups.

macosPrivacy.description: macOS grants each protected resource separately. Commands you run in a terminal inherit Se's grants, so a missing one surfaces as a command that fails for no visible reason.
macosPrivacy.unstableIdentity: This build carries no signing certificate, so its code identity changes every time it is rebuilt. macOS remembers every grant against that identity, which means permissions you approve now are forgotten after the next update and must be granted again.

localNetwork.label: Local Network
localNetwork.hint: Needed to reach devices on your LAN. Checks by sending one datagram to your router — that attempt is what makes macOS ask. Multicast and broadcast are gated separately and stay unavailable without an Apple-issued entitlement.

fullDiskAccess.label: Full Disk Access
fullDiskAccess.hint: Lets commands read protected locations such as Mail, Messages and other apps' containers.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.hint: Required by commands that control other apps or synthesise input.

screenRecording.label: Screen Recording
screenRecording.hint: Required by screenshot and screen-capture commands.

inputMonitoring.label: Input Monitoring
inputMonitoring.hint: Required by commands that read the keyboard outside the focused window.

desktopFolder.label: Desktop Folder
desktopFolder.hint: Checking lists the folder — that attempt is what makes macOS ask.

documentsFolder.label: Documents Folder
documentsFolder.hint: Checking lists the folder — that attempt is what makes macOS ask.

downloadsFolder.label: Downloads Folder
downloadsFolder.hint: Checking lists the folder — that attempt is what makes macOS ask.

macosPrivacy.checkHint: Runs the real operation. macOS may show a permission prompt.
macosPrivacy.deniedCaveat: "Not granted" can also mean macOS has never asked. Approve in System Settings, then re-check — this list only updates when a check runs. If Local Network already reads as on in System Settings but still shows here as not granted, macOS has the grant stuck: unmount any mounted installer disk images, delete other copies of the app, then quit and relaunch.
